definition_quote.value: "Real estate broker" includes any person, partnership, association, limited liability company, limited liability partnership, or corporation, foreign or domestic, who for another, whether pursuant to a power of attorney or otherwise, and who for a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, or with the intention, or in the expectation, or upon the promise of receiving or collecting a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration does any of the following: (1) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents, or leases, or negotiates the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of any real estate...
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" includes any person, partnership, association, limited liability company, limited liability partnership, or corporation, foreign or domestic, who for another, whether pursuant to a power of attorney or otherwise, and who for a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, or with the intention, or in the expectation, or upon the promise of receiving or collecting a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration does any of the following

value: Selling, exchanging, purchasing, renting, or leasing, or negotiating the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of any real estate
Offering, attempting, or agreeing to negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of any real estate
Listing, or offering, attempting, or agreeing to list, or auctioning, or offering, attempting, or agreeing to auction, any real estate
Buying or offering to buy, selling or offering to sell, or otherwise dealing in options on real estate
Operating, managing, or renting, or offering or attempting to operate, manage, or rent, any building or portions of buildings to the public as tenants
Advertising or holding self out as engaged in the business of selling, exchanging, purchasing, renting, or leasing real estate
Directing or assisting in the procuring of prospects or the negotiation of any transaction calculated to result in the sale, exchange, leasing, or renting of any real estate
Charging an advance fee or contracting for collection of a fee in connection with promoting the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of real estate through listing in a publication
Collecting rental information for purposes of referring prospective tenants to rental units and charging prospective tenants a fee
methods_authorized.quote: Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents, or leases, or negotiates the sale, exchange, purchase, rental, or leasing of any real estate

exam_application_window_years.quote: An applicant who has completed the requirements of division (B)(6) of this section at the time of application shall be examined no later than twelve months after the applicant is notified of admission to the examination.

value: Agency relationship between the licensee and the seller
Agency relationship between the licensee and the purchaser
Dual agency relationship between the licensee and both the seller and the purchaser
Subagency relationship between the licensee and the client of another licensee
agency_relationship_types.quote: The types of agency relationships a licensee may establish in a real estate transaction are limited to the following: (1) An agency relationship between the licensee and the seller; (2) An agency relationship between the licensee and the purchaser; (3) A dual agency relationship between the licensee and both the seller and the purchaser; (4) A subagency relationship between the licensee and the client of another licensee.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: No licensee or brokerage shall participate in a dual agency relationship described in section 4735.70 of the Revised Code unless both the seller and the purchaser in the transaction have full knowledge of the dual representation and consent in writing to the dual representation on the agency disclosure statement

designated_agency_permitted.quote: When two licensees affiliated with the same brokerage represent separate clients in the same transaction, each affiliated licensee shall do both of the following: (1) Serve as the agent of only the party in the transaction the licensee agreed to represent

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A licensee working directly with a purchaser in a real estate transaction, whether as the purchaser's agent, the seller's agent, or the seller's subagent, shall provide the purchaser with the brokerage policy on agency described in this section and obtain a signature from the purchaser acknowledging receipt of the policy

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A licensee shall enter into a written agency agreement before doing any of the following: (1) Advertising or showing residential real property on behalf of a seller; (2) Making an offer to purchase residential real property on behalf of a purchaser

value: An expiration date

A statement that it is illegal to refuse to sell, transfer, assign, rent, lease, sublease, or finance housing accommodations because of race, color, religion, sex, familial status, ancestry, military status, disability, or national origin
A statement defining blockbusting and stating that it is illegal
A copy of the HUD equal housing opportunity logotype
A statement that the licensee is appointed as an agent of the client, and whether the agency relationship is exclusive or nonexclusive
The terms by which the real estate broker is to be compensated
A conspicuous statement that broker fees and commissions are not set by law, are fully negotiable, and may be paid by the seller, the buyer, the landlord, the tenant, or a third party
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: The written agency agreement shall contain all of the following: (1) An expiration date; (2) A statement that it is illegal... (3) A statement defining the practice known as 'blockbusting'... (4) A copy of the United States department of housing and urban development equal housing opportunity logotype... (5) A statement that the licensee is appointed as an agent of the client... (6) The terms by which the real estate broker is to be compensated; (7) A conspicuous statement that broker fees and commissions are not set by law, are fully negotiable

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Having failed to put definite expiration dates in all written agency agreements to which the broker is a party

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Having failed to keep complete and accurate records of all transactions for a period of three years from the date of the transaction

escrow_account_required.quote: Failure to maintain at all times a special or trust bank account in a depository of a state or federally chartered institution located in this state. The account shall be noninterest-bearing, separate and distinct from any personal or other account of the broker, and... shall be used for the deposit and maintenance of all escrow funds, security deposits, and other moneys received by the broker in a fiduciary capacity.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: The account shall be noninterest-bearing, separate and distinct from any personal or other account of the broker

fixed_office_required.quote: Every real estate broker licensed under this chapter shall have and maintain a definite place of business in this state. A post office box address is not a definite place of business for purposes of this section.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Each branch office shall be in the charge of a licensed broker or salesperson.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: "Real estate salesperson" means any person associated with a licensed real estate broker to do or to deal in any acts or transactions set out or comprehended by the definition of a real estate broker

qualified_association_permitted.quote: A licensed real estate broker may pay all or part of a fee, commission, or other compensation earned by an affiliated licensee to a partnership, association, limited liability company, limited liability partnership, or corporation that is not licensed as a real estate broker on the condition that all of the following conditions are satisfied

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The real estate recovery fund is hereby created in the state treasury, to be administered by the superintendent of real estate.

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: the liability of the fund shall not exceed forty thousand dollars for any one licensee.

value: Owner selling their own real estate (not by way of repeated or successive transactions)

license_exemptions.quote: The terms "real estate broker," "real estate salesperson," "foreign real estate dealer," and "foreign real estate salesperson" do not include a person, partnership, association, limited liability company, limited liability partnership, or corporation, or the regular employees thereof, who perform any of the acts or transactions specified or comprehended in division (A) of this section
